name: EWA Splatting Renderer (Mesh-Free)
definition: A mesh-free rendering pipeline that projects raw point clouds (xyz, rgb, label) directly to 2D camera views using EWA projection and Z-buffer occlusion, producing RGB images, label maps, and 2D-to-3D index maps without mesh reconstruction.
summary: The EWA Splatting Renderer (Mesh-Free) projects raw point clouds to 2D views using simplified screen-aligned spherical impostors, avoiding mesh reconstruction and per-point normals.
